purpose: Visual architecture, verified findings, implementation scope, active gate and hardening roadmap. This is navigation state, not runtime authority.
authority_rule: Current repository source, local runtime evidence, acceptance results and exact repository state outrank this map.

nodes.title: Single reasoning agent
nodes.summary: Agent owns strategy and tool choice. Runtime owns governed execution and lifecycle truth. Transport is not a second reasoning agent.

nodes.title: Structured provider/tool loop
nodes.summary: LiveAgentCore calls provider.complete(), executes typed ToolRegistry tools, records tool observations/evidence, then re-enters provider reasoning.

nodes.title: Durable explicit session state
nodes.summary: AgentSessionState projects running/retrying/waiting/stopped/cancelled/completed/failed/blocked/timed_out plus active action, observations, pending instructions and completion truth.

nodes.title: Bounded DOM interaction map
nodes.summary: browserSnapshot returns bounded visible text and visible interactive nodes with temporary aa-N refs. Raw HTML is not sent to the model.

nodes.title: Persistent managed Chrome profile
nodes.summary: Managed Chrome uses an Access-owned reusable user-data-dir, preserving transport login but also sharing browser storage across task browsing.

nodes.title: Agent semantic event dispatch
nodes.summary: fcb533d preload normalization is live-proven: execution.tool.started and execution.tool.completed visibly reach the renderer.

nodes.title: Post-result continuation
nodes.summary: A→B→C live behavior proved next assistant turns are independently ingested with newSession:false.

nodes.title: Candidate readiness without activation
nodes.summary: Candidate provider testing no longer mutates active provider authority.

nodes.title: Blocked terminal renderer source
nodes.summary: Blocked/failed/stopped source semantics and focused regression are proven; live acceptance waits on runtime termination control.

nodes.title: Repeated browserConversationRead loop
nodes.summary: turn-37c41f6e450f190f repeatedly completed browserConversationRead, returned to provider reasoning, and requested another read without terminal progress.

nodes.title: No-progress contract proven absent at baseline
nodes.summary: b2b6ff3 added the failing regression. Expected blocked/no_progress_stagnation after two duplicate observations; baseline runtime returned completed.

nodes.title: P1.1 source implementation committed
nodes.summary: 741d208 changes only LiveAgentCore.js (+53/-5) to add step-local observation hashing, first-duplicate transient warning, runtime.no_progress, and second-duplicate no_progress_stagnation interception. Local regression proof is still pending.

nodes.title: Browser settlement too weak
nodes.summary: Navigation readiness is document.readyState interactive/complete; non-navigation click uses fixed 100 ms then downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED. No bounded mutation/network/hydration settle contract is proven.

nodes.title: Task browsing shares persistent profile
nodes.summary: Persistent profile is correct for ChatGPT transport identity but general browsing lacks an isolated ephemeral task-context lifecycle.

nodes.title: Native AX + screenshot not implemented
nodes.summary: Current semantics are DOM-derived. Native CDP AX tree and optional screenshot dual perception remain future hardening.

nodes.title: P1 Runtime Progress / Re-entry Contract
nodes.summary: Source implementation exists at 741d208. Prove the focused no-progress regression and existing runtime resilience regression before live Browser Loop revalidation or moving to P1 settlement.

nodes.title: ADD — progress truth primitives
nodes.summary: 741d208 adds stable normalized args/output fingerprinting, SHA-256 observation fingerprint, step-local duplicate counter, transient RUNTIME_NO_STATE_CHANGE notice, runtime.no_progress event, and no_progress_stagnation blocker.

nodes.title: CHANGE — provider re-entry boundary
nodes.summary: 741d208 allows one transient provider-facing runtime notice on first duplicate and intercepts the second duplicate before another provider.complete(). The 40-call budget remains the final fuse.

nodes.title: REMOVE — provider-only progress detection
nodes.summary: The runtime no longer relies solely on the provider to detect exact repeated observations. Model strategy authority is preserved.

nodes.title: DO NOT TOUCH
nodes.summary: 741d208 does not alter newSession:false, Browser Relay transport semantics, durable tool evidence, provider selection, or reasoning ownership.

nodes.title: P1 Bounded page settlement
nodes.summary: Replace fixed post-click wait as primary settlement with navigation detection, DOM mutation quiet window, bounded activity settle, state revision and timeout classification.

nodes.title: P1 Durable Stop terminal receipt
nodes.summary: Prove Agent Stop yields durable stopped/cancelled state and clears executing recovery ambiguity.

nodes.title: P1 turn-37c recovery
nodes.summary: Remains unresolved until explicit reconciliation receipt is observed.

nodes.title: P1 Terminal-state UI live acceptance
nodes.summary: Resume BLOCKED/FAILED/STOPPED live rendering acceptance after runtime termination/reconciliation is controlled.

nodes.title: P1 AttachConsole owner map
nodes.summary: Observed after prolonged runtime; occurrence proven, causality not proven.

nodes.title: P1/P2 Isolated task browser contexts
nodes.summary: Keep persistent relay identity while adding task-scoped ephemeral cookies/storage/cache lifecycle for general browsing.

nodes.title: P2 AX tree + visual perception
nodes.summary: Add bounded native Chromium AX representation and optional screenshot for layout/CSS/canvas verification.

nodes.title: P1 Cline auth live persistence
nodes.summary: Requires successful supported login, durable credential creation and restart proof.

nodes.title: P1 Arbitrary process-death recovery
nodes.summary: Validate exactly-once behavior across executing/delivering/delivery_unverified boundaries.

nodes.title: P2 CSP inline-style violations
nodes.summary: Observed but non-blocking to current renderer boot.

nodes.title: P2 Parallel settings cleanup
nodes.summary: Prove compatibility imports before removal/consolidation.
